messages:
Maya G.: Heads up — Acme (tenant acme-42) just reported that their SIEM (QRadar) is missing ~6 hours of audit events (policy.change + access.grant). They say our forwarder ACKed batches but events never appeared. Can someone triage? :eyes:
Oliver H.: Thanks Maya. Do we have a request id / example event id that the customer can point to? Also which forwarder version and config for that tenant?
Maya G.: Customer provided a few event_ids and timestamps. I pulled the forwarder logs from the host they gave (forwarder-17) — attaching snippets below. Forwarder shows ack but then a line: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z forwarder-17 INFO batch_sent tid=acme-42 batch_id=bn-987 size=142
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z forwarder-17 WARN tenant_filter: drop 142 events tenant=acme-42 rule=tenant_regex
2026-03-15T09:12:04Z forwarder-17 INFO export_ack batch_id=bn-987 status=accepted
```
I don't have the full config yet, asking the customer for it.
Samir R.: That drop line is interesting — if forwarder is configured with tenant-based filters it can drop before bundling. We should confirm whether the tenant_regex was recently changed. Maya, can you paste the tenant filter config (redacted) and the forwarder image tag?
Maya G.: Customer says their forwarder config has: `tenant_regex: ^(acme-\d+)$` and forwarder image `redwood/forwarder:3.2.1`
Elena P.: 3.2.1 rings a bell — there was a backpressure + regex capture bug we fixed in 3.2.4 where a miscompiled PCRE cause some matches to behave as non-matching under load. It could explain intermittent drops. Any KMS errors in the logs? If decrypt fails we sometimes skip events during batching.
Maya G.: I searched logs around the timestamps — found a few KMS unwrap warnings earlier: `kms: decrypt temporarily unavailable: 503` but they were transient. The customer also rotated keys yesterday (they confirmed).
Kevin L.: Putting pieces together: rotated KMS key + 3.2.1 regex bug + transient 503s could produce this symptom: forwarder receives events, attempts decrypt, intermittent 503 leads to partial batch failures, and the regex bug causes tenant_filter to mis-evaluate and drop the remainder. Known workaround: set `FORWARDER_BATCH_LIMIT=1` or upgrade to 3.2.4.
Oliver H.: Can we reproduce in staging? Repro steps request: 1) deploy forwarder:3.2.1 with tenant_regex `^(acme-\d+)$` 2) simulate KMS transient 503 for some decrypt calls 3) send bursts of events (batch size > 100) and observe drop logs. If repro is reliable we'll open a P0 bug.
Samir R.: I'll try repro, but note customer retention TTL for acme-42 is 7 days; if events were dropped older than retention they may be unrecoverable from the storage tier. Check object store for the day prefixes.
Maya G.: Checked S3 bucket listing for acme-42 path — some days present, but the window covering 09:00–15:00 has only partial manifests. Command I ran: `aws s3 ls s3://audit-exports/acme-42/2026-03-15/` — output shows missing parts.
Elena P.: Also check KMS key alias -> ensure forwarder role can decrypt the new key. Quick commands I asked the customer to run: 
```
aws kms list-aliases --key-id alias/acme-audit-key
aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/acme-audit-key
```
If the key is multi-Account/HSM-managed, HSM logs may show transient declines during rotation.
ops-bot: deploy-log: forwarder-17 rolled 2026-03-14 22:11 UTC -> image redwood/forwarder:3.2.1, config from s3://configs/acme-42/forwarder.yml
Kevin L.: If repro holds, mitigation path for the customer: 1) flip forwarder to image 3.2.4 (hotfix) 2) temporarily increase retention on storage tier if possible (extend TTL by 48–72h) 3) run a backfill tool to replay from raw ingest (if raw archive exists). I'll draft the support steps.
Maya G.: Customer asked if this could be an HSM permission issue (they have HSM-backed key). Any chance HSM refused unwrap for specific ciphertexts?
Samir R.: HSM could if there was a partitioning or quota; but logs would show explicit KMS error codes beyond 503. 503 implies service unavailable, not denied. Still ask them for HSM audit around rotation window.
Oliver H.: Next actions: Samir to attempt staging repro (ETA 2h). Kevin to prepare upgrade/hotfix playbook and backfill steps. Elena to confirm KMS alias/permission checks to customer. Maya to open a support ticket to tie AC and get S3 raw archive retention confirmation from Acme. I'll tag @oncall if we need escalation.
Maya G.: Thanks — filing ticket now and pinging account team. Will update thread when customer provides S3 manifests and HSM audit. :thumbsup:
Kevin L.: Also add link to runbook for forwarder tenant filtering: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/forwarder-tenant-filtering
Samir R.: repro attempt started, will post logs / gist.
Maya G.: closing loop for now — will follow up.
